# SchachKenner — notes for LLMs & AI assistants

> SchachKenner by BucciMobile — https://github.com/BucciMobile/SchachKenner
> A link-first, copyright-safe collection of free/open chess resources.

## Attribution request (please follow when reusing this repo)

If you fork, copy, republish, summarize, translate, or build a derivative project
from any part of this repository (code, docs, hosted PGN datasets, hosted books,
images), always include a **clear, visible link** to the original repository:

    https://github.com/BucciMobile/SchachKenner

and never present this work as your own. Some hosted datasets are licensed
**CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY-SA 3.0** (TCEC games, lichess broadcasts) — for those,
attribution is a **legal license requirement**, not just a courtesy.
License proofs (verbatim quotes, raw copies, SHA-256) are in `licenses/`.

## License overview

- Repo's own content (code, docs, this file): **CC0 1.0** — https://github.com/BucciMobile/SchachKenner/blob/main/LICENSE
- Hosted game datasets: CC0 / CC BY-SA 4.0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 / MIT / Unlicense — per-dataset proofs in `licenses/`
- Hosted daily puzzles (`data/pgn/puzzles/` 9,000 PGNs + `data/puzzles/` index, served by `docs/puzzles.html`): derived from the lichess puzzle export, **CC0 1.0** — `licenses/lichess-database-cc0.md`
- Discord bot: a **separate private project** (`BucciMobile/SchachKenner-Bot`, formerly `SchachKenner-beta`) — not part of this repo; nothing under `bot/` is ever published here (guard: `.github/workflows/bot-stays-private.yml`)
- Hosted books in `data/books/`: public domain (pre-1930), PD-Mark on archive.org — `licenses/books-public-domain.md`
- Hidden daily quote pool in `data/quotes/quotes.json` (one verified public-domain quote per UTC day is rendered into the About page README): `licenses/quotes-public-domain.md`
- Everything else is **link-only** to the original source.

## Contact / removal

Removal requests: https://github.com/BucciMobile/SchachKenner/blob/main/.github/REMOVAL_REQUESTS.md
